description: This PHP class 'EmbeddedURLForVimeo' is part of a plugin system for processing Vimeo video URLs. It provides functionality to extract an embeddable Vimeo URL from various input URL formats, validating and normalizing the URLs accordingly.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForVimeo
classes.description: A class that processes and generates embedded Vimeo URLs from various input formats.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns a normalized embedded Vimeo URL if the input URL matches known Vimeo patterns; throws an exception otherwise.
